provider.en: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk. · Mentored by Slimstock
provider.id: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk. · Mentor dari Slimstock

summary.en: Training on using Slim4 (Slimstock) for inventory planning and optimization. Covered exception management through the To-do dashboard, prioritization with the Covey matrix, order parameter calculation (order level, cover period, EOQ/MOQ), stocked/non-stocked policies, and phase-out and substitute item management.
summary.id: Pelatihan penggunaan Slim4 (Slimstock) untuk perencanaan dan optimasi persediaan. Materi meliputi pengelolaan exception melalui To-do dashboard, penentuan prioritas dengan matriks Covey, perhitungan parameter pemesanan (order level, cover period, EOQ/MOQ), kebijakan stok stocked/non-stocked, serta pengelolaan phase-out dan item pengganti.

provider.en: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk. · Delivered by CBS consultants
provider.id: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk. · Dibawakan konsultan CBS

summary.en: Attended SAP S/4HANA MM module end-user training delivered by CBS consultants as part of PT Vale Indonesia's ERP system migration (carve-out). Covered material master data, MRP, Business Partner & Manufacturer Code, and E-Catalogue.
summary.id: Mengikuti pelatihan end-user SAP S/4HANA modul MM yang dibawakan konsultan CBS, sebagai bagian dari migrasi sistem ERP PT Vale Indonesia (carve-out). Materi meliputi material master data, MRP, Business Partner & Manufacturer Code, serta E-Catalogue.

summary.en: Intensive training in JIT, Heijunka, Jidoka and Kaizen, with hands-on operational simulations.
summary.id: Pelatihan intensif JIT, Heijunka, Jidoka dan Kaizen dengan simulasi operasional langsung.

summary.en: Completed Digital Skola’s Business Intelligence Bootcamp, covering Python, SQL, Excel, data analytics, BI dashboarding, and machine learning fundamentals, with hands-on projects in data automation, dashboard development, and data-driven decision-making.
summary.id: Menyelesaikan Bootcamp Business Intelligence di Digital Skola dengan pembelajaran Python, SQL, Excel, analisis data, dashboard Business Intelligence, dan dasar machine learning. Menerapkan keterampilan tersebut melalui proyek otomasi data, pengembangan dashboard, dan pengambilan keputusan berbasis data.

summary.en: Completed the Microsoft Power BI specialization in MySkill’s Data Science & Data Analysis learning path: 12 courses over 12 hours of study.
summary.id: Menyelesaikan spesialisasi Microsoft Power BI pada learning path Data Science & Data Analysis di MySkill: 12 kursus dengan total 12 jam belajar.
